name: TicketWeb API
tagline: Live entertainment ticketing inventory for venues and promoters (US-focused).
description: TicketWeb is a Ticketmaster-operated self-service ticketing, marketing, and event-management platform for independent venues and promoters. Custom website integrations use Ticketmaster's Discovery API, whose public datasets include TicketWeb-sourced listings across North American and international markets. Transactional offers and near-real-time inventory status are separate partner or authorized-client APIs.

auth.details: Authentication method not yet verified against current official documentation.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unknown as a free tier; the official current FAQ only identifies a default public-API quota of 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second.

rate_limits: Default public-API quota: 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second.
use_cases: search live events by city or venue
list upcoming shows for a promoter inventory feed
